params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: landing-feedback  Priority: P2  Area: site
Summary: Reorder the site into five sections: landing page, Infrastructure, Services, How we work, News and insights. The current nav (Services, Verifiable AI, Networks, How we work, Blog) mixes product, technology and content, and a visitor cannot see the path from "what is this" to "what can I buy".

## What is asked
- Main sections in this order: landing page, Infrastructure, Services, How we work, News and insights.
- "Networks" and the ISBE network service provider page become Infrastructure (see the Infrastructure issue).
- "Verifiable AI" moves under Services (it becomes the volition example, see the Services issue).
- "Blog" becomes News and insights.

## Open
- Whether the existing URLs stay (networks.html, blog.html) or get redirects.

Source: Portal mail:6 (feedback on the website content, forwarded by the owner). The client asks for the owner's view first, so this is a proposal to agree on before building.
params.title: Reorder the site into landing, Infrastructure, Services, How we work, News and insights
